description: A 3HP phase distortion oscillator of the Casio CZ kind, putting out the Reso 2 waveform

params.text: Sets the pitch in semitones, 0 giving C4 at 261.63Hz and reaching 54 semitones either side of that
Detunes the pitch by up to three semitones either way
Sets how far the wave is distorted, from the plain shape at one end of its travel to the fully distorted one at the other; with the shape mod jack patched it attenuates that voltage instead

inputs.text: Added to the pitch, a volt per octave
The voltage here divided by 10, scaled by the shape knob, sets how far the wave is distorted

menu: DC Block — strips the constant offset that the resonant shapes carry
